articles.summary: Today, we announced that FTI Capital Advisors served as the financial advisor to Telkom SA SOC Limited on the sale completion of its masts and towers business.
articles.title: FTI Capital Advisors Facilitates the Closing of Telkom’s Masts and Towers Business Deal

articles.summary: Alcoa also meets obligation with planned smelter restart Today, Alcoa Corporation (NYSE: AA, ASX: AAI) and IGNIS Equity Holdings, SL (IGNIS EQT), the majority shareholder in the IGNIS Group of Companies, a vertically integrated energy company based in Spain, announced they have entered into a joint venture agreement to support the continued operation of Alcoas San Ciprin complex. Under the joint venture agreement, effective March 31, 2025, Alcoa will own a 75 percent interest and continue as the managing operator and IGNIS EQT will own a 25 percent interest. Alcoa and IGNIS EQT contributed $81 (75) million and $27 (25) million, respectively, to form the joint venture and fund the operations. Additionally, up to $108 (100) million may be funded by Alcoa as needed for operations with a priority position in future cash returns. Further funding requires agreement by both partners and the funding would be shared 75 percent by Alcoa and 25 percent by IGNIS
articles.title: FTI Consulting Spain and FTI Capital Advisors Spain acted as financial and M&A advisors to Alcoa in the formation of its joint venture with IGNIS EQT.
